body.heading: Help can accidentally shrink people
paragraphs: Take over someone's task and you may finish it faster — while quietly telling them they were not capable. Help that humiliates is a mixed gift, and people often refuse the next offer because of how the last one felt.
The goal of help is not a finished task. It is a person who feels more capable and less alone than before you arrived.

body.heading: Ask, assist, step back
paragraphs: Ask what would actually help — the answer is often smaller and different from your plan. Assist with the part they hand you, not the whole job. And step back when your part is done, without hovering for gratitude.
With kids, elders, and anyone proud, this matters double. Doing the hard ten percent while they do the rest preserves dignity and still gets the job done.

description: Good help leaves the other person in charge of their own life. Here is how to offer support without seizing the steering wheel.
